title: Administrator (HR)
description:
HR Administrator
Based in Kirkcaldy hybrid working available (Monday & Wednesday in-office days)
Full Time hours Monday to Friday 36 hours per week
ASAP start
Ongoing Temp role initially strong potential to become permanent
Pay rate up to 14.50 per hour + holiday pay (depending on experience)
Search Consultancy are delighted to be partnered exclusively with a leading business in Fife to recruit this role on an initial temp contract with a view to becoming permanent.
The successful candidate will be responsible for providing comprehensive Administration support to the HR team across a number of functions to ensure that the team can provide a professional HR service across the business.
The client is keen to move quickly to fill this role - on this basis only candidates who are available to start immediately or candidates on short notice will be considered.
Duties involved in this role will include:
Acting as a first point of contact for all managers & employees that require support with general HR or Payroll queries
Investigating and escalating payroll queries to the company's payroll provider
Preparing correspondence & documents to be signed-off by the HR Advisors / Head of HR
Administration of Long Service Awards, flexible working requests & early retirement applications
Preparing and maintaining Excel sheets
Collating and verifying pre-employment checks, ensuring they have been completed in line with company policies
Processing of all new starter documentation & contract changes on the company HR system, submitting required documentation to the company's payroll provider
Updating staff details throughout the employee lifecycle
Providing sickness & absence information to managers on request to assist in the monitoring of absence triggers
Assisting in the audit of the HR database to ensure that all information is accurate and up-to-date
Collating and maintaining electronic staff files
General administration for the team including processing of department mail, filing, photocopying & scanning of documents - as well as ad hoc tasks as directed
In order to be considered for this role your skills and experience should include:
Previous experience within an Administration role - this experience is ESSENTIAL - candidates with previous HR or Recruitment Administration would be preferred, although this is not essential as training would be provided
Excellent interpersonal & communication skills, both written and verbal as you will be dealing with people of all levels within the business daily
Excellent organisation skills, with the ability to prioritise & complete a busy workload effectively and the ability to pivot your focus where required
Solid IT Skills including the full MS office suite (particularly Excel) - HR systems experience would be advantageous
If this is the role for you, apply now!
Please note that only applicants who have the required skills and experience detailed above will be considered for this role.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age

title: Receptionist
description:

Location: Dunfermline

Hourly Rate: 12.71

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Job Role: Finance Assistant

Location: Kirkcaldy

Contract Type: Temporary, Full-Time

Salary: 28,000 - 32,000 per annum, depending on experience

Our client, a dynamic organisation in the construction sector, is seeking a talented Finance Assistant to join their team on a temporary basis. This is not just a standard accounts payable position; it's an exciting opportunity to be an integral part of a rapidly growing group of businesses. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a passion for finance, this role could be the perfect fit!

What's in Store?

As a Finance Assistant, you will play a vital role in the accounts payable function, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in managing supplier invoices, approvals, and payment runs. Your responsibilities will include:

Accounts Payable Management: Taking ownership of supplier invoices across various group companies, ensuring timely and accurate payments.

Supplier Reconciliations & Relationships: Reconciling monthly supplier statements and swiftly resolving any queries to maintain positive supplier relations.

Overhead Reviews: Analysing running costs site by site to identify savings opportunities and eliminate any duplicate charges.

KPI & MI Contribution: Feeding essential cost data into weekly and monthly KPI trackers, supporting the leadership team with critical management information.

AI & Automation Utilisation: Harnessing the power of AI tools to streamline manual processes and contribute to the development of smarter finance operations.

What Makes This Role Exciting?

Work directly with cutting-edge AI tools, enhancing your skills in a modern finance environment.

Enjoy a competitive salary with opportunities for growth, including support towards your AAT qualification.

Experience a vibrant and entrepreneurial work culture that encourages innovation and collaboration.

Benefit from increasing holiday pay with length of service, along with discounts in retail stores and restaurants.

What's Needed?

The ideal candidate will possess:

1-2 years of experience in accounts payable, purchase ledger, or a similar finance role.

Proficiency in Excel and a strong comfort level with numbers.

A genuine curiosity about how technology and AI can enhance finance functions.

Experience with Xero and/or an AAT qualification (or pursuing one) is advantageous.

Most importantly, our client is looking for a detail-oriented professional with a can-do attitude who is eager to grow alongside the organisation.

Ready to Elevate Your Career?

This role is based at our client's head office in Kirkcaldy, and candidates must be available for on-site work during scheduled hours. If you're excited about the prospect of making a tangible impact within a thriving company, apply now!

Our client is eager to find the right candidate who can start as soon as possible. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to be part of a forward-thinking finance team!

To apply, please submit your CV and cover letter today.

title: Temporary Finance Assistant
description:
Temporary 6-12 Month Contract

Escape Recruitment Services are recruiting on behalf of a global manufacturing organisation based in Fife. This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established finance team in a varied accounting role. You will provide additional resource on a temporary basis for 6 to 12 months.

The Role
- Preparing accounting journals and balance sheet reconciliations
- Processing accounts payable and accounts receivable transactions
- Managing banking activities, including payment processing and cash allocation
- Creating and processing intercompany back-charge invoices and resolving related queries
- Supporting month-end and year-end accounting activities
- Ensuring financial records are maintained accurately and in line with company procedures

About You
- Previous experience in a similar Finance Assistant, Assistant Accountant, Bookkeeper or Ledger role
- Strong MS Excel experience is essential
- Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy
- Excellent organisational and time management skills
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team

title: Finance Officer
description:
Finance Officer
- Location: Glenrothes, Fife
- Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent
- Salary: £35,000 - £40,000 per annum

Reed Accountancy are delighted to be partnering with a well-established and highly regarded business in the heart of Fife to recruit an experienced Finance Officer.

This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional looking to take on a varied role that combines both operational and supervisory responsibilities. Reporting into the company directors, you will play a key role in the month-end process, maintaining transactional accounts, producing accurate financial reports, and supporting the wider finance function.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities:
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records
- Preparing and posting journals, accruals, and prepayments
- Maintaining the general ledger and reconciling balance sheet accounts
- Preparing and issuing customer sales invoices
- Monitoring customer accounts and following up overdue payments
- Processing supplier invoices, ensuring correct allocation of costs
- Reconciling supplier statements and preparing supplier payment schedules
- Ensuring timely processing and recording of customer receipts and supplier payments
- Monitoring daily cash receipts and payments
- Preparing and maintaining cash flow forecasts
- Reconciling bank statements with accounting records
- Preparing quarterly management accounts and financial reports for the Directors
- Preparing and submitting quarterly VAT returns
- Managing the monthly payroll process
- Supporting the preparation of annual financial statements and year-end accounts

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Experience in a similar accounting role
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Good problem-solving and decision-making skills
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written

Benefits:
- Join a stable and growing business
- Early finish on a Friday
- Competitive salary

title: Accounts Assistant (Manufacturer)
company: Ernest Gordon Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Assistant (Manufacturer)

£33,000 - £38,000 + Monday to Friday Only + Progression + Cycle to Work Scheme + Employee Discounts + Job Security

Glenrothes

Do you have experience in accounts payable or finance administration looking to join a well-established specialist manufacturer in a friendly, supportive workplace where everyone can contribute to its success?

With over 50 years of industry experience and a global customer base, this well-established company is continuing to expand its engineering and sales department to support its ongoing growth.

Day to day you will be supporting the Finance Director, processing purchasing invoices, maintaining ledger and correspondence records, reconciling supplier statements, maintaining Goods in Transit records and processing company expenses.

This role would suit an Accounting Assistant with experience in finance administration or purchase ledger, looking to join an expanding specialist manufacturer with opportunities for progression.

The Role:
- Processing purchasing/monthly/company expenses
- Maintaining purchase ledger & Goods in Transit records
- Managing petty cash and monthly financial housekeeping
- Supporting the Financial Director & wider accounts team

The Person:
- Experience in finance administration, purchase ledger or accounts payable

If this role interests you, click apply now!

Job reference: BBBH28258

Key words: Finance, Accounting, Purchasing, Supplier, Manufacturing, Expenses, Glenrothes, Scotland

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitable candidates. The salary advertised is a guideline for this position. The remuneration offered will be dependent on the extent of your experience, qualifications, and skillset.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Logistics Coordinator

Fife Permanent Monday to Friday

Are you someone who loves organisation, enjoys working with people and takes pride in keeping things running smoothly?

We're looking for a Logistics Coordinator to join a busy operation in Fife.

This is a varied position where you'll support the coordination of UK and international shipments, customer orders, transport arrangements and general operational activities.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating domestic and international shipments.
- Liaising with freight companies and transport providers.
- Preparing shipping and export documentation.
- Processing customer orders and arranging deliveries.
- Supporting stock control and inventory management.
- Managing customer enquiries and shared email accounts.
- Providing general operational and administrative support.

What we're looking for:
- Excellent organisational skills.
- Experience with international exports desired.
- Strong attention to detail.
- Confident communication skills.
- A proactive and dependable approach.
- Good computer skills.
- Someone comfortable managing several priorities at once.

The benefits:
- Competitive salary.
- 35 days' annual leave, including public holidays.
- Monday-Friday working.
- Supportive team environment.
- Opportunity to develop within logistics and international operations.

If you're looking for a varied role where you can develop your skills and take ownership of your work, get in touch to find out more.
